description: This file defines the MacroType enum used for representing macro command types such as IF, ELSE, ELSE_IF, and END. It includes a method to retrieve the MacroType based on a command string.

classes.name: MacroType
classes.description: An enum representing different macro command types used in macro processing.

methods.name: getForCommand
methods.description: Static method that returns the MacroType corresponding to a given command string, case-insensitive.
